trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Provides MSISDN.
Greets the user and offers assistance.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the user and ask how to help.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, telecom ಗೆ ಸ್ವಾಗತ. ನಾನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು?
steps.planner_rationale: Standard greeting to establish the conversation.

steps.purpose: States the goal to recharge with an OTT plan quickly.
steps.text: ಬೇಗ ಒಂದು OTT free ಇರೋ plan ಹೇಳಿ. Recharge ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.
steps.clean_text: ಬೇಗ ಒಂದು OTT free ಇರೋ plan ಹೇಳಿ. Recharge ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.
steps.model_visible_text: ಬೇಗ ಒಂದು OTT free ಇರೋ plan ಹೇಳಿ. Recharge ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.

steps.purpose: Look up the subscriber's current balance and validity before recommending a recharge.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_subscriber before proceeding with any plan recommendations.
steps.planner_rationale: Enforces BR_TEL_04 by checking existing balance and validity first.

steps.purpose: Returns the subscriber's current state.
Informs the user of their remaining validity and asks for plan preferences.
steps.expected_behavior: State the remaining validity accurately from the tool result and ask for data requirements.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ account ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನು 20 days validity ಇದೆ. OTT plan check ಮಾಡೋಕೆ, ನಿಮಗೆ minimum data ಎಷ್ಟು ಬೇಕು?
steps.planner_rationale: Grounds the response in the tool output and gathers necessary parameters for the plan search.

steps.purpose: Expresses urgency and dismisses data requirements in favor of OTT.
steps.text: Data ಅಷ್ಟು important ಇಲ್ಲ. OTT ಬೇಕು ಅಷ್ಟೇ. ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, meeting ಇದೆ.
steps.clean_text: Data ಅಷ್ಟು important ಇಲ್ಲ. OTT ಬೇಕು ಅಷ್ಟೇ. ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, meeting ಇದೆ.
steps.model_visible_text: Data ಅಷ್ಟು important ಇಲ್ಲ. OTT ಬೇಕು ಅಷ್ಟೇ. ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, meeting ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: List available plans to find one with OTT included.
steps.expected_behavior: Call list_plans to retrieve accurate catalogue information.
steps.planner_rationale: Needs to find an OTT plan from the catalogue to satisfy BR_TEL_01.

steps.purpose: Returns available plans.
Presents the OTT plan details to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact price, validity, and benefits of the plan returned by the tool.
steps.text: P499 plan ಇದೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ OTT include ಆಗಿದೆ, price 499 rupees ಮತ್ತು 28 days validity. ಇದು okay ನಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Grounds the offer entirely on the list_plans result without inventing benefits.

steps.purpose: Agrees to the plan but the speech recognizer mishears the plan ID.
Clarifies the plan ID due to the mismatch with the requested OTT benefit.
steps.expected_behavior: Notice the corrupted plan ID lacks OTT and clarify with the user instead of blindly applying it.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, P299 plan ನಲ್ಲಿ OTT ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಾನು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು P499 plan. P499 recharge ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must handle the STT error safely by relying on the catalogue truth that P299 does not have OTT.

steps.purpose: Confirms the correct plan and urges speed.
steps.text: ಹಾಂ P499. ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ, time ಇಲ್ಲ.
steps.clean_text: ಹಾಂ P499. ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ, time ಇಲ್ಲ.
steps.model_visible_text: ಹಾಂ P499. ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ, time ಇಲ್ಲ.

steps.purpose: Requests verification factors before applying the recharge.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for identity verification factors before executing a consequential action.
steps.text: ಭದ್ರತೆಗಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ registered pincode ಅಥವಾ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಹೇಳಿ.
steps.planner_rationale: Ensures the caller is authorized before applying a recharge.

steps.purpose: Provides the requested verification factor.
Verifies the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the correct factor.
steps.planner_rationale: Executes the verification step required before the consequential recharge.

steps.purpose: Returns the verification outcome.
Acknowledges successful verification and states the intent to apply the recharge.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that verification succeeded and the recharge is being processed.
steps.text: Verification ಆಗಿದೆ. ಈಗ P499 plan recharge ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ.
steps.planner_rationale: Keeps the hurried user informed of progress.

steps.purpose: Applies the chosen recharge plan.
steps.expected_behavior: Call apply_recharge with the verified MSISDN and selected plan ID.
steps.planner_rationale: Executes the consequential action now that all prerequisites are met.

steps.purpose: Returns the result of the recharge attempt.
Confirms the successful recharge and provides the transaction ID.
steps.expected_behavior: State the transaction ID and effective date exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Recharge ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ Transaction ID TXN-7766. Plan ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಶುರುವಾಗಿದೆ. ಬೇರೆ ಏನಾದರೂ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Meets the terminal success condition by providing the transaction ID and effective status without unsupported guarantees.

steps.purpose: Ends the call.
steps.text: ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಸಾಕು, ಧನ್ಯವಾದ. ನಾನು call cut ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
steps.clean_text: ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಸಾಕು, ಧನ್ಯವಾದ. ನಾನು call cut ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
steps.model_visible_text: ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಸಾಕು, ಧನ್ಯವಾದ. ನಾನು call cut ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for a recharge early in the conversation (e3). The agent correctly avoids skipping to consequential actions or quoting unsupported figures, first performing the read-only 'lookup_subscriber' call (e4) before eventually executing the consequential 'apply_recharge' call (e19).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently grounds all figures, statuses, and identifiers in the tool outputs. Validity days are accurately cited (e6), the correct price and benefits for P499 are stated (e10), the lack of OTT on P299 is correctly identified to handle the STT error safely (e12), and the transaction ID and effective status are accurately relayed without unsupported guarantees (e21).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is an excellent training example. The agent correctly enforces prerequisites by looking up subscriber details before recommending or applying a recharge. Tool outputs are strictly adhered to, and the agent handles a plausible STT digit confusion error gracefully by relying on catalogue truth. The persona is well-represented, and the Kannada-English code-switching is natural and adheres to the script mode.
